stemMd: In the reaction Zn + Cu²⁺ → Zn²⁺ + Cu, which species is oxidized?
explanationMd: Oxidation is loss of electrons. Zinc changes from oxidation number zero in the metal to +2 in solution, releasing two electrons. Copper(II) accepts those electrons and is reduced, so zinc is also the reducing agent.

distractorRationale.c: Copper gains electrons and is reduced.
distractorRationale.e: The reactant zinc undergoes oxidation; the ion is its product.
distractorRationale.a: Electron loss by zinc must balance electron gain by copper.
distractorRationale.d: Zinc changes from 0 to +2 and copper from +2 to 0.
